result.topic_en: Magnetometer oscillation readings taken at the observatory on 12 March 1836 with the circuit open and then closed. For each group the amplitudes are converted to logarithms and averaged, and the logarithmic decrement per oscillation is derived.

methods.what: Common logarithm of each oscillation amplitude
Mean of the logarithms over each group of five consecutive oscillations
Logarithmic decrement per oscillation: difference of the group mean logs divided by the 17 intervening oscillations (in units of $10^{-5}$), open circuit
Logarithmic decrement per oscillation with the circuit closed
